title: Treatments from follower not working
body: My son's phone is a master. Options "Be master for followers" and "Accept followers actions" are checked. But when I enter new carbs/insulin on my phone - the point is only on my phone. When my son do it on his phone - both are ok. What's wrong?

comments.body:
I've got the same setup - and 'it works for me'.  Actually we've got 2 followers (my wife and myself), and have successfully added treatments from any that get shown on all devices.

My setup is:
* Primary phone linked to Blucon (My son), setup as master with allow treatments from followers
* Secondary phone (with linked android watch), setup as follower
* Secondary phone (I don't have an android watch), setup as follower
* Self hosted nightscout (shouldn't be relevant)

Anything in the event log?

I'd suggest checking the system status to make sure that the master shows the follower(s), and the follower shows the master - but would expect you not to get graphs if they aren't set.  Same comment would be about the group security key.

Everything seems to be good, master shows followers and vice versa...
- Self hosted nightscout (shouldn't be relevant) - what does it mean?
Should MongoDB Sync be enabled on follower's phone?

@themotoden Would you please close this issue if your questions have been answered?
